# Synthetic test input; never execute as a workflow.
name: job-shell-body-fixture
'on': pull_request
permissions:
  contents: read
defaults:
  run:
    shell: pwsh
jobs:
  inspect:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    defaults:
      run:
        shell: sh
    steps:
      - name: Body with the job shell overriding the workflow shell
        run: printf '%s\n' "${{ github.event.pull_request.body }}"
